generation.scope: On every finite full-middle-support graph with at least seventeen geometric sites, opposite rank ten forces an opposite symmetry and rank eleven is impossible. At a planar Gorenstein length-four site, embedded conic pencils select one of two isotropic tangent directions. The only loss in the projected ruling bound is a socle contact, which produces rulings with the same tangent-plane factor in both re-marked four-spaces; the two-space incidence count then excludes it globally.

open_mathematics: On the finite one-sided symmetric rank-ten branch, use the commuting intersection of the two symmetric nets and the prescribed commutator compression to reduce the fully singular discriminant. On smaller supports track the placement of length-two conic contacts and individual slice rulings.
